name: aspect-ratio-icon
title: Aspect Ratio Icon
description: A shape's aspect ratio as an icon, such as beside "16:9" in a choice of an image's or video's size: a frame of that shape, its long side the icon's; a ratio it cannot read (e.g. "auto") is a dashed square. Sized and coloured as Hugeicons' icons are, in buttons, menus and toggles.
